operations.name: Shear Strip
operations.setup_note: HR13 sheet 4.5 mm (3.5 final + 0.9 side A + 0.1 side B lapping stock, note 2) sheared into 160 mm strip.

operations.name: Fine Blank Wheel
operations.setup_note: Compound fine-blanking tool, one stroke: 58 teeth and Ø149 tip circle, bore pre-pierced Ø98, Ø9 holes, Ø12 hole, oval and index slots. Die-roll side = side A (removed by the 0.9 mm side-A stock).

operations.name: CNC Turn Bore
operations.setup_note: Locate on Ø149 tooth tips (concentricity Ø0.1) and side B face. Bore Ø100.02 +0.054 (H8) Ra 3.2; side-A bore chamfer 2.4 x 45 deg before lapping (note 1, detail C) -> 1.5 after lapping.

operations.name: VMC Counterbore Mounting Holes
operations.setup_note: Fixture on Ø100.02 bore and index slot. 3 x Ø16.3 +/-0.1 counterbores on PCD Ø119.5, side A, depth 2.4 before lapping (1.5 +/-0.1 after), Ra 3.2, position Ø0.1 to P-Q.

operations.name: Rotary Surface Grind Side A
operations.setup_note: Blanchard grind side A 0.8 mm on magnetic chuck, full batch per load; removes fine-blanking die roll.

operations.name: Double-Side Lap
operations.setup_note: Lapping phase (note 2): side B 0.1, side A final 0.1 to thickness 3.5 +0.1 and counterbore depth 1.5 +/-0.1; flatness 0.2 both sides.

operations.name: Brush Deburr
operations.setup_note: Burrs not admitted; edge break 0.1 max; no rounding of tooth profile.

operations.name: DMC Laser Mark
operations.setup_note: DMC: P/N, supplier number, manufacturing date, serial number.

operations.name: Final Inspection
operations.setup_note: 100% teeth integrity check; bore H8, thickness, counterbore depth, flatness.

clarifications.question: Is a fine-blanking press available in house? Conventional stamping leaves fracture zone on the tooth flanks, which the drawing forbids.
Side A removal 0.9 mm: Blanchard grind 0.8 then lap 0.1, or lap the full 0.9 (much longer lapping cycle)?

assumptions.text: Sheet thickness 4.5 mm: 3.5 final + 0.9 side A + 0.1 side B (lapping note 2).
Counterbores Ø16.3 x 1.5 (2.4 before lapping) machined on VMC, not coined, because of Ra 3.2 and +/-0.1 depth.
No heat treatment required by the drawing.
